_comment: A full cube of Create's own andesite casing, authored facing north; blockstates/worker_station.json turns it. The casing is referenced, never copied -- the sprite lives in Create's jar and is resolved at runtime, which is also what lets CWConnectedTextures shift it to the connected sheet so a wall of these has no seams. The front carries no sunk panel: the lamps WorkerStationRenderer draws are mounted straight on the boards, which is where Create puts a fitting. One model for both has_job states, and one element on purpose: a block that fills its space occludes, lights and culls like any other solid block, which is what retires the holes and see-through edges the bench-and-board shape produced twice.

elements.__comment: The cabinet. Every face spans the block boundary, so every face culls.
